comments.body:
The respective package paths should also become:
fcrepo-kernel-api => org.fcrepo.kernel.api.*
fcrepo-kernel-modeshape => org.fcrepo.kernel.modeshape.*

Relevant PRs:
fcrepo4: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/846
message-consumer: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo-message-consumer/pull/86
auth-rbacl: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo-module-auth-rbacl/pull/16
auth-xacml: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo-module-auth-xacml/pull/38
fcrepo-camel: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo-camel/pull/80
fcrepo4-client: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-client/pull/24
fcrepo-audit: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-audit/pull/16
fcrepo-camel-toolbox: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-camel-toolbox/pull/41
webapp-plus: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-webapp-plus/pull/17
oaiprovider: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-oaiprovider/pull/20
swordserver: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-swordserver/pull/8
upgrade-utils: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-upgrade-utils/pull/6
upgrade-utils will fail `mvn javadoc:jar` and `mvn javadoc:test-aggregate` as is. I can do a separate pull request to fix that if need be.

All PRs have been merged.
...including migration-utils below.
